title: wholesome chewy Slovakian pistachio pastry
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Slovakia with this briny, chewy, ovo-vegetarian-friendly pastry featuring unsalted pistachios and a fermented twist.
instructions: Combine unsalted pistachio paste, granulated sugar, and active dry yeast in a mixing bowl.
Add large eggs, unsalted butter, and a pinch of flaky sea salt to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a rectangle.
Cut the rectangle into 12 equal pieces and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the pastry to cool completely before serving.
Serve warm with a dollop of plain yogurt and a sprinkle of fresh parsley and dill.
